speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness; have you had your baby via vaginal delivery or C-section, and when did the fever start?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis.

Based on your history of vaginal delivery with a prolonged labor, fever, uterine tenderness, and increased urinary frequency, this strongly suggests an infection of the uterine lining. I will now request your complete vital signs and a CBC with differential to confirm the presence of infection and guide treatment.
